courses.title: Je zelfgenezend vermogen versterken
courses.description: A Dutch-language online course by Frits Evelein in which each lesson pairs a short talk with his music and a guided visualisation. It works on feeling at home and connected in the body through the link between the Higher Self and the body's own capacity for balance.

courses.title: M42 Self-healing and Self-Sustainebility
courses.description: An album of thirteen tracks of Frits Evelein's Music from Source with a guided sequence of light visualisations through the body, from creating a sacred space to quiet integration. It is offered as energetic support for the body's natural balance.

left_out: Energizing Your Self-Sustaining & Self-Healing Abilities (fritsevelein.com/courses/selfhealing/): the page says 'This course is currently closed'; not current. (A student review on it also credits a similar method with healing an autoimmune disease.)
Insight Timer tracks titled for anxiety or self-healing: Insight Timer is never fetched, so not verified.
flags: Both restored items speak of activating the body's self-healing ability and 'Divine DNA' with energy and sound; no disease is named and no cure is claimed, so kept as energy and sound healing under the new rule.
